greeting: Egameni likaYise, neloNyana, neloMoya oyiNgcwele. Makube noxolo lweNkosi yethu uYesu Kristu kuni nonke.
penitential: Nkosi, usivele imfesane. Kristu, usivele imfesane. Nkosi, usivele imfesane.
homily:
Cinga ngomzuzu apho uBenjamin Vo, esesemncinci, ehlala phantsi ekhaya, echitha ixesha lakhe ebhala iikhowudi zeenkqubo zakhe zekhompyutha. Wayengumfana owayenomdla ongapheliyo, esakha ikamva lakhe ngengqondo eqaqambileyo eyayikwazi ukubona ngaphaya kwento ebonwa ngamehlo. Wayethanda ukucacisa ngale ‘con chim airlines’ yakhe, ebonisa ukuba intliziyo yakhe yayingeyiyo nje eyobuchwephesha, kodwa eyayizaliswe lithemba elikhulu. Namhlanje, kwiNcwadi kaGalati, uPawulos usikhumbuza inyaniso enzulu: 'Ngenxa yenkululeko, uKristu wasikhulula; ngoko ke yimani ngenkalipho, ningaphindi nizibambe kwidyokhwe yobukhoboka.' Apha, uPawulos uthetha ngesitshixo esikhulula intliziyo yethu kwisithokothoko sokuzama ukulawula yonke into, kwaye usikhokelela ekubeni sithembe uThixo. UBen wayeyazi le nto ngendlela yobuntwana bakhe. Wayengumfana owayephulaphula, owayenika, owayezama ukwenza uthando lube yinto ebonakalayo. Wayengumfana owayephila ngoxolo lukaKristu.

KwiVangeli yanamhlanje, uYesu uthi: 'Isizukulwana seli lixesha sisizukulwana esingendawo; sifuna umqondiso, kodwa akuyi kunikwa mqondiso, ngaphandle komqondiso kaYona.' Abantu kwixesha likaYesu babefuna ubungqina obubonakalayo, babefuna izimanga ezinkulu ukuze bakholelwe. Kodwa uYesu ubonisa ukuba umqondiso oyinyaniso awukho kwizinto ezinkulu ezimangalisayo, kodwa ukwintliziyo eguqukayo nephulaphulayo. UBen wayengumfana owayephila ngolu hlobo. Wayengumfana owayephila ngoxolo lukaKristu. WayengumSamariya olungileyo ebomini bakhe, ebonisa uthando olungenamiqathango. UBen wayengumfana owayephila ngoluxolo. Wayengumfana owayezisa uxolo ekhaya.

Alan noThao, ndiyazi ukuba kule nyanga yesithathu emva kokuba uBen ebuyele kuThixo, kukho imibuzo engapheliyo enikhathazayo. Kukho iintlungu ezihlaselayo xa ungazilindelanga. Mhlawumbi ucinga ngaloo mzuzu xa wayemi phambi kwekhompyutha yakhe, ebhala iikhowudi zokudala umdlalo wakhe, okanye xa wayecinga ngendlela i-'con chim airlines' yakhe eya kubhabha ngayo. Loo ntliziyo yayicocekile, yayingenabuxoki. Kwaye namhlanje, ndifuna ukuthetha inyaniso enzulu kakhulu: akukho nqaku lokuthi uphosile okanye wenze kakubi. Ukugula akwanga kwenzeka ngenxa yezinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. UThixo akakubeki icala, kwaye noBen akakubeki icala. Masikhuphe lo mthwalo wokuzisola emajukujukwini eentliziyo zenu namhlanje. Awuphosanga nto. Ubenze konke okusemandleni enu ngothando olungapheliyo. Ezinye izinto zenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lwethu, ngaphandle kokuba nabani na enze impazamo. Niyinyaniso, nithandwa nguThixo.

Khumbula indlela uBen awayenentliziyo enobubele ngayo. Khumbula loo mzuzu xa wayefuna ukunikela ngayo yonke imali yakhe yasebhange encinci ukuze ancede umalume wakhe uWilliam owayehlaselwe zizifo. Akazange ayiphule loo ngulube yemali, akazange ayikhuphule ngokoqobo, kodwa isipho sasingaphakathi entliziyweni yakhe. Wayengumfana owayenokunikela ngayo yonke into yakhe ngaphandle kokubala. Wayengumfana owayephila ngoxolo lukaKristu. WayengumSamariya olungileyo ebomini bakhe, ebonisa uthando olungenamiqathango. UBen wayengumfana owayephila ngoluxolo. Wayengumfana owayezisa uxolo ekhaya.

Ryan, mfowethu omncane, uBen uyaqhubeka ekuthanda. Khumbula indlela uBen awayekuthanda ngayo, indlela awayekujonga ngayo njengomntu okhethekileyo. Ungalokothi uzive ungedwa. UBen uyaqhubeka ehamba nawe. Xa uziva usizi, khumbula ukuba uBen uyaqhubeka ekhanya. Uthando lwakhe aluzange luphele; lusaqhubeka lukhanya njengolwandle olukhulu. Uthando lwenu luyaqhubeka luhleli, lusaqhubeka lukhula, kwaye uBen uyaqhubeka ekhanya. Benjamin, lala ngokuthula. Uthando lwakho lulukhanya olungasoze lwavaleleka. Siya kukukhumbula njalo, side sidibane kwakhona apho kungekho nyembezi, apho kukho uvuyo olungunaphakade. UYesu uthi: 'Ngenxa yenkululeko, uKristu wasikhulula.' Masiphile ke ngeli lizwi namhlanje, sithandane njengokuba uBen wayesithanda, kwaye sithembe ukuba uThixo uya kusikhokelela kude kube lixesha lokuba siphinde sidibane naye apho kungekho ntlungu, apho kukho uvuyo olungunaphakade. Amen.
spiritual_communion: Yesu wam, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukhona kwiSakramente engcwele. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwayo yonke into, kwaye ndinqwenela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Ekubeni ndingenako ngoku ukukwamkela kwiSakramente, nceda uze kum ngomoya. Ndiyakwamkela njengokuba sele ukhona, kwaye ndizimanyanisa ngokupheleleyo nawe. Ungandivumeli ukuba ndohlukane nawe nanini na. Amen.
closing: Ngamana uThixo onamandla onke angasithamsanqelisa, asigcine kuxolo lwakhe, asikhokelele kubomi obungunaphakade. Amen.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela uBen kunye nabo bonke abaswelekileyo, ukuze baphumle ekukhanyeni kukaKristu ngonaphakade.
Sithandazela abo bonke abasentlungwini, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele kwaye abaphe ithemba eliqinileyo.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: Bazalwana: Kubhaliwe ukuba uAbraham wayenoonyana ababini, omnye ngumfazi owayesikhoboka, omnye ngumfazi owayekhululekile. Unyana womfazi owayesikhoboka wazalwa ngokwemvelo, unyana womfazi owayekhululekile wazalwa ngesithembiso. Oku ke kungumzekeliso. Aba bafazi bamele iminqophiso emibini. Omnye wawusuka eNtabeni yeSinayi, uzala abantwana bobukhoboka; leyo yiHagare. Kodwa iYerusalem engaphezulu ikhululekile, kwaye ngumama wethu. Kuba kubhaliwe: 'Vuya, wena mfazi ulinyumba ongazange wazala; gqabuka ukhale, wena ungazange waba semsebenzini wokuzala; kuba baninzi abantwana balowo ushiyweyo kunabalowo unomyeni.' Ngoko ke, bazalwana, asibantwana bomfazi owayesikhoboka, kodwa sibantwana bomfazi owayekhululekile. Ngenxa yenkululeko, uKristu wasikhulula; ngoko ke yimani ngenkalipho, ningaphindi nizibambe kwidyokhwe yobukhoboka.

readings.label: INdumiso
readings.text: R. Malibongwe igama leNkosi ngonaphakade. Dumisani, nina bakhonzi beNKOSI, dumisani igama leNKOSI. Malibongwe igama leNKOSI ngoku kwanangonaphakade. R. Malibongwe igama leNkosi ngonaphakade. Ukususela ekuphumeni kwelanga kude kuye ekutshoneni kwalo, malidunyiswe igama leNKOSI. Phezulu phezu kweentlanga zonke iNKOSI; phezu kwamazulu uzuko lwayo. R. Malibongwe igama leNkosi ngonaphakade. Ngubani onjengeNKOSI, uThixo wethu, okhangela amazulu nehlabathi elingezantsi? Uphakamisa abaphantsi eluthulini; emdaka uphakamisa amahlwempu. R. Malibongwe igama leNkosi ngonaphakade.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: Ngethuba isihlwele sisanda ukuhlanganisana, uYesu wathi kubo: 'Isizukulwana seli lixesha sisizukulwana esingendawo; sifuna umqondiso, kodwa akuyi kunikwa mqondiso, ngaphandle komqondiso kaYona. Njengokuba uYona waba ngumqondiso kumaNiniwe, uya kuba njalo uNyana woMntu kwesi sizukulwana. Ekugwetyweni, ukumkanikazi wakumzantsi uya kuvuka naba bantu besizukulwana, aze abagwebe, kuba weza evela eziphelweni zehlabathi ukuza kuva ubulumko bukaSolomon, kwaye kukho into enkulu kunoSolomon apha. Ekugwetyweni, amadoda aseNiniwe aya kuvuka nesi sizukulwana aze asigwebe, kuba ekushumayeleni kukaYona baguquka, kwaye kukho into enkulu kunoYona apha.'

day: Monday of the Twenty-eighth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.text: Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben
